title: Horse dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <!-- back legs (raised, dancing) -->
  <rect x='62' y='70' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#8B4513' transform='rotate(-30 66 79)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='68' width='8' height='16' rx='4' fill='#A0522D' transform='rotate(-20 72 76)'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#A0522D' transform='rotate(15 34 78)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='70' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#8B4513' transform='rotate(-10 28 79)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#C06020'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M32 55 Q28 40 34 30 L44 30 Q40 42 42 55 Z' fill='#C06020'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#D07030' transform='rotate(-15 36 26)'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M44 24 Q50 20 48 30 Q54 28 50 36 L44 34 Z' fill='#8B0000'/>
  <path d='M40 18 Q46 12 44 22 Q50 18 46 28 L40 26 Z' fill='#8B0000'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M30 18 L28 10 L34 15 Z' fill='#D07030'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='34.8' cy='23.5' r='1' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='30' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#E08040'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='29' r='1' fill='#3a2010'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M22 33 Q26 36 30 33' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 58 Q84 50 82 62 Q86 58 84 68 Q80 64 78 70 Z' fill='#8B0000'/>
  <!-- dancing shoes/hooves -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='88' r='5' fill='#4B0082'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='88' r='5' fill='#4B0082'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='86' r='5' fill='#4B0082'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='82' r='5' fill='#4B0082'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#00E5FF'>
    <circle cx='78' cy='28' r='3'/>
    <rect x='80' y='16' width='2' height='12' fill='#00E5FF'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='40' r='2.5'/>
    <rect x='89.5' y='30' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#00E5FF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFD700'>
    <path d='M14 50 l2 4 4 1 -3 3 1 4 -4 -2 -4 2 1 -4 -3 -3 4 -1z'/>
    <path d='M88 72 l1.5 3 3 0.7 -2 2 0.5 3 -3 -1.5 -3 1.5 0.5 -3 -2 -2 3 -0.7z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
